report.skipped.title: Skipped and manual controls
report.skipped.intro: Skipped controls do not count towards the score.
report.skipped.na.title: Not applicable on this host
report.skipped.na.desc: These controls were skipped because the software, file or device they check is not present or was not provided.
report.skipped.na.empty: No controls were skipped as not applicable.
report.skipped.manual.title: Manual review
report.skipped.manual.desc: These controls cannot be checked automatically. A person has to verify them using the instructions shown.
report.skipped.manual.empty: No manual controls were included. Add --include-manual to a scan to list them.
report.about.title: About this report
report.about.tool.title: Tool
report.about.tool.name: Tool
report.about.counts.title: Rule counts
report.about.options.title: Scan options
report.about.read.title: How to read the score
report.about.read.formula: The score is the number of passed controls divided by the number of controls that were evaluated (passed plus failed), shown as a percentage. Skipped controls are left out.
report.about.read.bands: 90% or more is shown as well hardened, 70% to 89% as needs attention, and below 70% as at risk. These bands are a guide, not a certification.
report.about.read.severity: Severity shows how much a failed control matters. Fix critical and high items first.
report.about.read.status: A status is never shown by colour alone: each one also has an icon and a text label.
report.about.legal.title: Legal
report.about.legal.disclaimer: This report is an automated technical assessment. It is not a certification, an audit opinion or legal advice. Review every remediation before you apply it, and test it outside production first.
